title: Coastal Jet CJ-638 cancelled - claimant's SMS contradicts the carrier's notification log

dispute.narrative: My Coastal Jet flight CJ-638 DEL-BOM was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Vikram Nair
Booking reference (PNR): 39H593
Flight: CJ-638 DEL-BOM departing 16-Sep-2026 21:55 IST
Base fare INR 6,500.00 | Fuel charge INR 1,250.00 | Taxes and fees INR 1,170.00
Total paid INR 8,920.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Vikram, Coastal Jet regrets that flight CJ-638 DEL-BOM scheduled 16-Sep-2026 21:55 IST is cancelled. Sent 16-Sep-2026 18:55 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking 39H593 on CJ-638; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Coastal Jet: I request INR 8,920.00 for the cancellation of CJ-638 (PNR 39H593) on 16 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
